notes.title: “THOSE GAMES EXTREME” is now available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=5gwqJ8rAgG0;full][/previewyoutube]
Pushing the envelope! The third in the series, [b]“THOSE GAMES EXTREME”[/b] is now available!

Play upgraded, more difficult versions of familiar minigames to your heart's content!

THOSE GAMES EXTREME is a minigame collection that ramps up the difficulty and fun factor!
Play upgraded, harder versions of minigames from [b]THOSE GAMES 1 and 2[/b]!
Take on the minigames you know and love, now with a whole new layer of hardcore challenge and replayability!

Purchase during the first 14 days of launch to receive [b]20% off[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3246190/

[h3]Includes 155 stages of 6 types of mini-games![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/99eef0d18e1976edc12bf4f2f426d91d3af6a183.jpg[/img]

Featuring new versions of THOSE GAMES staples, all with updated visuals, including [b]Pin Pull, Number Tower, Color Lab, Knock-Back Shooter, Draw & Guard[/b], and Spellbinding Scroll (now upgraded to [b]Survival Scroll[/b]!).

Are you ready for the hardest instalment in the THOSE GAMES series yet? Are you ready...for THOSE GAMES EXTREME?!

“LISTEN UP! WE TRIED TO MAKE “THOSE GAMES” EVEN MORE EXTREME! SOME THINGS HAVE TO BE LEARNED THE HARD WAY!” is now available for purchase on Steam.

notes.title: “THOSE GAMES 1+2” AVAILABLE NOW!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/28327beab5bc41794527dcb27a674dc12e97d042.png[/img]

Get ready for a double dose of fun with the combined release of the popular [b]“Those Games”[/b] and [b]“Those Games 2”[/b]!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42936/

“Those Games” series is a collection of mini-games that you wanted to play to your heart's content, but couldn't, so we created this game with cute and funny stickman characters that you can play fully, thoroughly and enjoyably as many times as you like!

This product is a bundle that includes both the popular “Those Games” and “Those Games 2”.

This bundle offers [b]a massive total of 10 games and 500 stages[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/ac263f617b3bfa17256bf7976050a61273861daa.jpg[/img]
Games included in “Those Games”:
[b]“Pin Pull”, “Number Tower”, “Color Lab”, “Parking Lot”, “Cash Run”[/b]

Games included in “Those Games 2”:
[b]“Knock-Back Shooter”, “Pin Pull 2”, “Draw & Guard”, “Numbers Dungeon”, “Spellbinding Scroll”[/b]

“YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 1+2” is now available for purchase on Steam.


* “YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 1+2” is a bundle of the currently available “Those Games” and “Those Games 2”. There are no additional elements included. Please be careful not to purchase duplicates.
* The download versions of “Those Games” and “Those Games 2” are also available for purchase separately.

notes.title: Let's play "Those Games 2" for brain exercise during break time!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109371/c0d35f77a513ac6ae4dad1ba418072389c02360e.jpg[/img]

[b]"YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 2"[/b] is available now on Steam Store.

The mini-game [b]"Numbers Dungeon"[/b] included in "Those Games 2" is a puzzle game in which players take turns defeating enemies whose numbers are smaller than their own.

By adding the numbers of defeated enemies to your own numbers, you will be able to take on stronger and stronger enemies.

Sometimes you can pick up an item that doubles your numbers, but other times you may be caught in a trap that halves them.....

Calculations such as addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division are key in figuring out the order in which to obtain items and defeat enemies.

Playing in a little spare time in a fun way can be a refreshing change of pace and a good exercise for your brain!

[h3]Other fun mini-games are also included![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109371/6bbdb4fe30edc1d6d8ccbc78393d175ff068edd7.jpg[/img]

A total of 250 stages in five types are included, including [b]"Knock-Back Shooter"[/b], a game in which players use walls to knock down monsters, [b]"Pin Pull 2"[/b] in which they pull pins to save the king from a pinch, [b]"Draw & Guard"[/b] in which they draw lines to save a cat from bats, and [b]"Spellbinding Scroll"[/b] in which they make numbers bigger to attract boys!

notes.title: "Those Games2" is now available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/cb5d167a51eb302471809eeae5bd4e48a5c649fd.jpg[/img]

"Those Games" are back! Play through familiar minigames to your heart's content! Take on five different minigames with a total of 250 stages!

Enjoy the newly added mini-games to your heart's content at your own pace!

[h2]Challenge players from around the world![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392250/5ed9be86fad95f4c8789f4dc700c7915fb2d8aa3.png[/img]

Clearing all minigame stages will unlock a Rank-Up Challenge, where you can compare your score and clear time to other players in monthly rankings.

Ranking is based on each mini-game or a mix of five different mini-games, with “Easy,” “Normal,” and “Difficult” levels for each.

[b]"YEAH! YOU WANT "THOSE GAMES," RIGHT? SO HERE YOU GO! NOW, LET'S SEE YOU CLEAR THEM! 2"[/b] is available now on Steam.
